Behold, a son shall be born to you, who shall be a man of peace. I will give him rest from all his enemies all around…
In his days, the righteous shall flourish, and abundance of peace, until the moon is no more.

So the assemblies throughout all Judea, Galilee, and Samaria had peace, and were built up. They were multiplied…

translations.web: But now Yahweh my God has given me rest on every side. There is no enemy and no evil occurrence.
translations.bsb: But now the LORD my God has given me rest on every side, and there is no adversary or crisis.
translations.kjv: But now the LORD my God hath given me rest on every side, so that there is neither adversary nor evil occurrent.
translations.asv: But now Jehovah my God hath given me rest on every side; there is neither adversary, nor evil occurrence.
